question: If 9 men or 4 women can plan and execute a wedding in 39 days then 2 men and 2 women together finish the whole work in how many days?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__****Given:**

9 men or 4 women = 39 days

**Concept Used:**

Efficiency = Work/Time

If a man or b women can do a piece of work in d days then x men and y women together finish the whole work in:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dbde3495b9f5239092047f66b503fffc22872a4ecad27193c735a5a88dca69b.png] 

Days = (a × b × d)/(xb~+~ya)

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bf8fcef608d3a91e417ac39fd990545015cf7dd80e7b9bc827d5f15b5c705ec.png] 

Days = (a × b × d)/(xb~+~ya)

⇒ (9 × 4 × 39)/(2× 4~+~2× 9) = (9 × 4 × 39)/(26)

⇒ 54 days

∴ Total time taken by 2 men and 2 women to finish the work is 54 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

10 men or 15 women = 25 days

**Concept Used:**

Efficiency = Work/Time

If M₁ men can do W₁ work in D₁ days working H₁ hour/day and M₂ men can do W₂ work in D₂ days working H₂ hour/day having efficiencies x and y respectively then,

(xM₁D₁H₁)/(W₁) = (yM₂D₂H₂)/(W₂)

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

9 men or 4 women = 39 days

Efficiency of 1 women = (9)/(4) men

​M1D1 = M2D2

⇒ 9 men × 39 = (2 men + 2 women) × D2

⇒ 9 men × 39 = (2 men + 2 × (9)/(4) men) × D₂ 

⇒ 351 men = ((13)/(2) men) × D₂ 

D2 = 54 days

**∴ Total time taken by 2 men and 2 women to finish the work is 54 days.**
